    None,
    kCGEventLeftMouseDown,
    CGPointMake(485, 863),
    kCGMouseButtonLeft
)
CGEventPost(kCGHIDEventTap, event)

# Release
event = CGEventCreateMouseEvent(
    None,
    kCGEventLeftMouseUp,
    CGPointMake(485, 863),
    kCGMouseButtonLeft
)
CGEventPost(kCGHIDEventTap, event)

    # Create mouse up event

        None,
        kCGEventLeftMouseUp,
        button_pos,
        0

    event_up.post(kCGHIDEventTap)
    
    print("Clicked Open button")
else:
